name: CloudGPU
description: Rent GPUs with source-specific minute or started-hour billing from an MCP client: live GPU prices and quotes, instances created from an approved quote with a budget and time limit, background commands, log tailing, SFTP upload and download, and destroy to stop billing; the same key also lists models on CloudGPU's OpenAI-compatible model API. Requires an API key and prepaid balance; `CLOUDGPU_READ_ONLY=1` exposes only the look-up tools. Install: `npx -y cloudgpu-mcp` (set `CLOUDGPU_API_KEY`) · [Docs](https://github.com/cloudgpu-app/cloudgpu-mcp#readme)
